name: לֹא רֻחָמָה
summary: The daughter of Hosea and Gomer, named by Yahweh “for I will no more have compassion on the house of Israel” (Hos 1:6). The name is לֹא “not” with the pual perfect רֻחָמָה “she has been shown compassion”, and scripture explains it itself. Its reversal is promised: “say to your sisters, Ruhamah” (Hos 2:3), and “I will have compassion on Lo-ruhamah” (Hos 2:25), which Paul and Peter apply to those God has called (Rom 9:25; 1Pe 2:10).

evidence.note: “Call her name לֹא רֻחָמָה, for I will no more have compassion (אֲרַחֵם) on the house of Israel.”
“I will have compassion on Lo-ruhamah, and I will say to Lo-ammi, You are my people.”
“Who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.”

note: Takes l.ab.ad (the name, filed under לא) and t.bz.ah (רֻחָמָה, a zero-token cross-reference); lo.json leaves the name out. The database also files the Hos 1:6, 8 and 2:25 name tokens under the verb t.bz.ad with no stem.
